answer: Signed-history replay audits. Each identity keeps a river of signed work receipts, one per epoch, hash-chained to the previous one. Every epoch a public beacon picks 3 random old receipts per identity and demands full re-execution within 10 minutes; a mismatch or miss resets its chain. Only identities with 20 consecutive replayed receipts reach the ferrous tier that earns full rewards. Each fake must do 20 real tasks plus 3 replays per epoch, so 500 fakes need 10,000 receipts, a canyon no shared budget crosses.
